module "P_Filters.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Filters"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  buffer "Mask" R8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  pass "ByStencil" mesh injection=AfterOpaque
    filter Stencil(4, 15) | Stencil(8, 255)
    mesh mode=Own depth=TestScene cull=Auto blend=Replace usage=default nanite=StencilMask naniteValue=(1, 0, 0, 0)
    write Output0 = Mask
  pass "ByLayer" mesh injection=AfterOpaque
    filter Layer(A | B) & Stencil(1, 255) | List(Enemies) & Stencil(1, 255)
    mesh mode=Own depth=TestScene cull=Auto blend=Replace usage=default nanite=StencilMask naniteValue=(1, 0, 0, 0)
    write Output0 = Mask
